latest_publication.trend_or_durable_demand: Active September 2026 decision-stage demand. Current search results include fresh guides specifically targeting when not to automate, manual-versus-automated decisions and human-led exceptions.
latest_publication.evidence_source_and_date: Repository library and live web search reviewed 23 September 2026. Current results repeatedly cover unstable processes, low-volume work, judgement-heavy work, unreliable data, fallback design and ownership. The Olivers Consulting library had no dedicated no-go decision page.
latest_publication.existing_article_gap: The library covers what to automate first, readiness, cost, architecture and mistakes, but lacked a dedicated page for rejecting, delaying or narrowing an automation candidate.

comparison_against_previous_12.why_meaningfully_distinct: The prioritisation page ranks good candidates, readiness checks whether a chosen process is buildable, and the mistakes page covers implementation failure. latest_publication.first_hand_contribution_or_limits: Uses practical automation, business-analysis, data-quality and control-design reasoning. The three-outcome test is explicitly an editorial decision framework, not empirical research.
